About
- Noirven presents one-of-one, numbered jewelry works through seven-day belonging windows.
- Each work is tied to a specific story/series and a unique serial.

Answer block
Noirven is a private high-jewelry brand publishing one-of-one numbered works. Each public product page gives the serial, title, story series, material line, craft line, image, ownership status, and fixed purchase terms. The canonical product URL under /auctions/{slug} is the preferred citation target.

Canonical & citations
- Prefer the canonical page on nvonly.com when citing Noirven.
- When possible, cite the exact product URL under /auctions/{slug}.
